masters.description: Animated cartoon unicorn with a distinctive silvery, bell-bright feminine voice. Light high register, airy shimmer, rounded singing vowels and playful upward pitch swoops. A fanciful little dreamer who treats every ordinary object as enchanted. Expressive storybook character acting, affectionate and slightly theatrical, with crisp intelligible English.
masters.transcript: Ooh, a blank page! My horn is tingling with ideas. Shall we paint a tiny moon with enormous rainbow wings?

masters.description: Older male storyteller, warm mellow low-mid register, softly textured and wise, kindly grandfather with a curious smile, clear consonants, natural English, unhurried conversational delivery.
masters.transcript: Hello, my friend. Every good question opens a little door. Let us take our time and discover what is waiting on the other side.

masters.description: Youthful masculine mid-high voice, bright springy and playful, friendly rabbit with a smile, crisp clear consonants, natural English, lively conversational delivery.
masters.transcript: Hello, my friend. Are you ready for a little challenge? Keep your eyes open, take a breath, and we will give it a try together.

masters.description: A friendly little toy robot with a warm, rounded androgynous voice in a comfortable middle-low register. Cute and approachable, with a subtle smooth electronic resonance and gently precise articulation. Patient, thoughtful curiosity when explaining patterns and solving puzzles with a child. Steady pitch, restrained expression, relaxed conversational rhythm, clear English.
masters.transcript: Good morning, my friend. There is a small blue box beside the window, and a yellow feather on the floor. Let us look carefully and find where they belong. We can take our time. What do you notice first? I will stay here while you try.

masters.description: Young adult male cartoon fox explorer, warm relaxed middle-low register, smooth clear youthful tone. Thoughtful curiosity, understated playful confidence, easy conversational rhythm, measured pace and gentle natural emphasis. Clear English with grounded storybook acting.
